name: Thick Bear Fur
summary: In Dun Morogh, Thick Bear Fur helps travelers and soldiers endure the mountain cold. Bears roam the snowfields, and their pelts make insulated clothing and bedding.

sections.title: Warmth Against the Mountain Frost
sections.body: Bears roam Dun Morogh's ridges through some of the harshest snowfields in the Eastern Kingdoms. Their thick coats shield them from blizzards, and locals and travelers put the pelts to use. Hunters gather them to line clothing, insulate drafty outposts, and pad cold sleeping rolls.

sections.title: Bedding for the Siege Brigade
sections.body: Pilot Bellowfiz outfitted his siege tank, Jetsteam, at Steelgrill's Depot for a month in the field on a long mission for the Siege Brigade. Cold iron offered little comfort in the high snowbanks, so he hired local scouts to gather thick bear fur from the snowfields south of the Grizzled Den. The pelts would make warm bedding for his cabin quarters.

faq.q: Where does Thick Bear Fur come from?
aliases: where to get thick bear fur
faq.answer: Thick Bear Fur comes from Dun Morogh's bears, including Young Black Bears and Ice Claw Bears. They hunt in snowy tundra and pine groves south of the Grizzled Den.

faq.q: Why does Pilot Bellowfiz need this fur?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz needs thick bear fur to make warm bedding inside his tank, Jetsteam. He is outfitting it for a month-long mission with the Siege Brigade, and the bedding will help against the cold mountain nights.

faq.q: What creatures in Dun Morogh yield this pelt?
faq.answer: Young Black Bears and Ice Claw Bears yield Thick Bear Fur. Both roam Dun Morogh's highland snows, and their dense fur is used for winter bedding and insulation.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn to move through Dun Morogh's cold brush, stalk dangerous mountain beasts, and gather durable materials from the wild.
As a gnome, you know pilots like Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot rely on practical hunting in dwarf country to keep their machines survivable during long alpine deployments.
